description.fun: A robotic Volcarona that a paranormal magazine said was a UFO sent to watch humanity, maybe ahead of an invasion. It descends from the sky, follows people around and sometimes attacks, firing its little feet like bullets and reloading from inside its body. Its look may draw on foo fighters, fireball-like UFOs, and on space telescopes such as James Webb, with wings like solar panels.
description.guide: A Fire and Poison-type Paradox Pokémon found in Pokémon Violet, said to be either a future relative of Volcarona or a version of it from a parallel timeline. Its ancient counterpart is Slither Wing.
description.tagline: A robot Volcarona rumoured to be a UFO watching humanity
